candidates.change_summary: Replaced the owner equality check with a call sender != owner so that only non-owners can call sendTo, changing who can trigger transfers.
Replaced the transfer amount with amount - 1, so calls transfer one wei less (will revert if amount is 0), altering final balances observable after sendTo.
Removed the require check so anyone can call sendTo, changing who may invoke transfers and thus observable behavior.
Changed transfer target from receiver to owner so funds are sent to owner instead of the provided receiver, altering post-call balances.
Added a require that amount == 0 so only zero-amount transfers succeed, changing observable state changes from nonzero transfers to none.
